# SearchParams WPT cases

The [Go tests](../../url/searchparams_test.go) port applicable cases from
[web-platform-tests/url](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/c48d58747e1f211527fb695fd60548a997fae617/url)
at revision `c48d58747e1f211527fb695fd60548a997fae617`, the same revision as the
vendored URL parser fixtures. Upstream code and derived vectors are covered by
the accompanying [BSD license](LICENSE.md).

Run with `go test ./url -run '^TestWPTSearchParams' -count=1` from the repository
root. These tests also run with `go test ./...` and require only Go.

The two JSON files contain the input/output arrays copied from
`urlencoded-parser.any.js` (35 vectors) and `urlsearchparams-sort.any.js`
(8 vectors). Expected values are upstream literals, not generated by this
library. The remaining tests are direct Go adaptations; related cases are
occasionally consolidated into tables.

| Upstream file | Go coverage |
| --- | --- |
| `urlencoded-parser.any.js` | All 35 SearchParams parsing vectors. Fetch Request/Response `formData()` cases are outside this library. |
| `urlsearchparams-sort.any.js` | All 8 vectors, both directly and through an associated URL; removing an empty query. |
| `urlsearchparams-constructor.any.js` | String parsing: plus, spaces, NUL, escaped bytes, Unicode, malformed escapes, and encoded-plus round trips. |
| `urlsearchparams-append.any.js` | Repeated names, empty strings, and multiple values. |
| `urlsearchparams-get.any.js` | First value, absent keys, and empty names/values. |
| `urlsearchparams-getall.any.js` | Ordered duplicates, missing keys, empty values, and replacement by Set. |
| `urlsearchparams-has.any.js` | Name lookup and deletion. Two-argument `has(name, value)` has no Go counterpart. |
| `urlsearchparams-set.any.js` | Replacing duplicates, preserving position, and appending a missing name. |
| `urlsearchparams-delete.any.js` | Single-argument deletion, duplicates, empty query removal, and opaque paths. Two-argument deletion has no Go counterpart. |
| `urlsearchparams-stringifier.any.js` | Escaping names/values, empty fields, malformed escapes, newline preservation, and URL synchronization. |
| `url-searchparams.any.js` | Object identity, search assignment, clearing, and bidirectional update propagation. |
| `urlsearchparams-foreach.any.js` | Basic and empty traversal through Go Iterate. Live mutation during JS iteration is not covered. |
| `urlsearchparams-size.any.js` | Not ported: there is no public Size method. |

The Go API has no standalone SearchParams constructor. Tests of string parsing
initialize its private form tuples directly, avoiding URL preprocessing of
literal NULs and whitespace. This exercises the parser used by SearchParams;
it does not claim coverage of JavaScript constructor overloads or leading-`?`
removal by that constructor. Associated-URL cases use the public URL API.

JavaScript-specific conversion of null, undefined, and numbers is represented
by the corresponding strings. Missing `get()` results are checked with Go's
`Has` plus empty-string `Get` convention. Prototype/branding checks, records,
iterables, object constructors, FormData/DOMException, readonly JS properties,
and assignment to `url.href` are not claimed as tested. Neither are browser
bindings, a public live iterator, or APIs absent from this Go library. This is
a port of applicable cases, not execution of the complete JavaScript suite.

To update, review the listed source files at the new WPT revision, copy the two
vector arrays as JSON, and reconcile the Go cases and this coverage table.
Update `REVISION` and the source link together. The existing `testdata/wpt-url/refresh.sh`
updates the parser JSON fixtures only; it does not automatically update these
manual ports.
